final.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.cdscode, s.fundingtype,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enr, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct,
         sat.avgscrread, sat.avgscrmath, sat.avgscrwrite
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
  WHERE s.charter = 1 AND s.statustype = 'Active' AND s.fundingtype IN ('Directly funded','Locally funded')
)
SELECT fundingtype,
  count(DISTINCT cdscode) AS schools,
  sum(enr) AS total_enrollment,
  round((avg(pct)*100)::numeric, 2) AS avg_frpm_pct_0_100,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN avgscrread IS NOT NULL AND avgscrmath IS NOT NULL AND avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL THEN avgscrread+avgscrmath+avgscrwrite END)::numeric, 2) AS avg_sat
FROM base GROUP BY fundingtype ORDER BY fundingtype

WITH w AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
acc AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS n_accts FROM account GROUP BY district_id
),
so AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount) AS total_orders
  FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT d.a2, d.a3, d.a4::bigint AS population, w.total_withdrawn,
         ROUND(w.total_withdrawn::numeric / d.a4::bigint, 2) AS wpi,
         ROUND(COALESCE(so.total_orders, 0)::numeric / acc.n_accts, 2) AS avg_so
  FROM district d
  JOIN w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN acc ON acc.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN so ON so.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.a4::bigint >= 100000
)
SELECT a2, a3, population, total_withdrawn, wpi,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wpi DESC) AS withdrawal_rank,
       avg_so
FROM base
ORDER BY withdrawal_rank, a2

WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.setcode, c.manacost,
    CASE WHEN c.manacost IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (
      SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m[1] ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN m[1]::int WHEN m[1] = 'X' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 0)
      FROM regexp_matches(c.manacost, '\{([^}]+)\}', 'g') AS m) END AS mv
  FROM cards c WHERE c.setcode IN ('USG','TSR')
)
SELECT s.name, t.setcode, COUNT(*) AS total_cards,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.mv <= 3) AS cheap,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.mv <= 3) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct
FROM t JOIN sets s ON s.code = t.setcode
GROUP BY s.name, t.setcode ORDER BY t.setcode

WITH wd AS (SELECT a.district_id, sum(t.amount)::numeric tot FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id=t.account_id GROUP BY a.district_id),
acc AS (SELECT district_id, count(*)::numeric n FROM account GROUP BY district_id),
so AS (SELECT a.district_id, sum(o.amount)::numeric s FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id=o.account_id GROUP BY a.district_id),
base AS (
  SELECT d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4::bigint AS population, wd.tot AS total_withdrawn,
         round(wd.tot / d.a4::bigint, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
         round(coalesce(so.s,0) / acc.n, 2) AS avg_standing_order_per_account
  FROM district d
  JOIN wd ON wd.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN acc ON acc.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN so ON so.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.a4::bigint >= 100000
)
SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
       rank() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS rank_per_inhabitant,
       avg_standing_order_per_account
FROM base
ORDER BY rank_per_inhabitant, district_name
